title: Daily transfer activity
caption: Daily number of unique ERC-20 transfers and of distinct active addresses (senders or receivers), after reconstructing unique transfers from the overlapping TGS snapshots. Thin lines: daily values; thick lines: 7-day centred moving average. Logarithmic y-axis; days without transfers are not drawn.
graph_definition: event stream (no graph aggregation; filters not applied)

title: Replication of transfers across TGS snapshots
caption: Ratio between raw edge-list rows and reconstructed unique transfers per calendar day. Each TGS snapshot is a 7-day sliding window with a 1-day stride, so interior days are repeated in 7 snapshots and boundary days in fewer. Every transfer key was found with identical multiplicity in all snapshots covering its date (see the deduplication audit).
graph_definition: raw edge lists (before aggregation)

title: Degree and strength distributions
caption: Empirical complementary cumulative distributions on log-log axes. Dashed lines show the discrete power-law maximum-likelihood fit above the KS-optimal x_min (Clauset et al., 2009), scaled by the tail share. A straight-looking tail is not evidence of a power law; the formal comparison with alternative distributions is in tail_fits.csv and Figure 4.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed

title: Tail model comparison
caption: Conditional CCDF of the tail (x >= x_min) with four maximum-likelihood models fitted on the same tail. Bootstrap goodness-of-fit p-values (p_GOF >= 0.1: power law plausible) and likelihood-ratio tests are reported in tail_fits.csv; the interpretation column there uses heavy-tailed language only.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed; undirected degree on the undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed)

title: Volume strength distributions
caption: CCDF of address in- and out-strength in the raw-volume graph, expressed as a share of the token's total transferred volume so that tokens with different units can share an axis (x-axis from the 0.5th percentile of positive values). Dashed: continuous power-law fit above x_min. Raw token amounts are on-chain integer units and are not comparable in absolute terms across tokens.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed; pairs with zero total volume removed

title: Concentration of activity
caption: Share of total volume or degree held by the top fraction of addresses (log x-axis); the grey curve marks perfect equality (share held = fraction of addresses). Legend values are Gini coefficients. Concentration describes structural activity only and does not identify the role of any address.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed
weight_definition: raw token volume (a, b); unweighted degree (c, d)
source_artifacts: RARI/concentration_curve.csv; RARI/concentration.csv; SWAP/concentration_curve.csv; SWAP/concentration.csv; BITCOIN/concentration_curve.csv; BITCOIN/concentration.csv; SUPER/concentration_curve.csv; SUPER/concentration.csv

title: Monthly evolution of network structure
caption: Structural descriptors of disjoint calendar-month graphs. Hollow markers denote months with less than 80% calendar coverage (first and last months), whose size is not comparable. Clustering and modularity are computed on the undirected projection; modularity uses Leiden at resolution 1 on transfer-count weights; Gini refers to address out-strength in the raw-volume graph.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed; clustering/modularity on the undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed)
weight_definition: unweighted topology (a-f), transfer count (g), raw volume (h)

title: Comparison with degree-preserving null graphs
caption: Observed global clustering and average shortest-path length of each monthly undirected projection divided by the mean over 20 degree-preserving rewired graphs (10 swaps per edge); sigma = (C/C_null)/(L/L_null). Path lengths are measured on the largest connected component, exactly up to 5,000 nodes and from 500 seeded sources above. A small-world reading needs sigma clearly above 1 with L/L_null close to 1.
graph_definition: undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed), unweighted
source_artifacts: RARI/topology.csv; RARI/null_samples.csv; SWAP/topology.csv; SWAP/null_samples.csv; BITCOIN/topology.csv; BITCOIN/null_samples.csv; SUPER/topology.csv; SUPER/null_samples.csv

title: Normalised rich-club coefficient
caption: Rich-club coefficient phi(k) of addresses with degree above k, divided by its mean over the degree-preserving null graphs. Shaded bands: +-2 null standard deviations relative to the null mean. rho > 1 indicates that high-degree addresses are more interconnected than expected from the degree sequence alone.
graph_definition: undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed), unweighted

title: Bow-tie structure
caption: Bow-tie decomposition of the directed graph around its largest strongly connected component (core): IN reaches the core, OUT is reached from it, tendrils/tubes are the rest of the largest weakly connected component, and disconnected nodes lie outside it.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed

title: Agreement between centrality measures
caption: Spearman rank correlations between node centralities, computed over the nodes where both measures are defined (harmonic closeness is restricted to the candidate set when the graph exceeds the exact-computation threshold; see centrality_status.csv). Betweenness and harmonic closeness use distance = 1/log(1 + w).
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed

title: Persistence of the most central addresses
caption: Jaccard overlap between the top-k addresses of consecutive months for three centrality measures (Kendall's tau on the union of both top-k sets is in rank_stability.csv). Hollow markers involve a partial month.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed

title: Address and tie turnover
caption: Share of the previous month's active addresses (a) and directed ties (b) that are observed again in the following month.
graph_definition: directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed

title: Community structure
caption: Leiden communities of the weighted undirected projection (transfer-count weights). (a) CCDF of community sizes at resolution 1. (b, c) Resolution sweep with a fixed seed. (d) Adjusted Rand index between Leiden partitions obtained with different seeds. Communities are algorithmic groupings of addresses with dense mutual transfers, not real-world groups.
graph_definition: undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed)

title: Addresses shared between token networks
caption: (a) Jaccard similarity of the address sets of two tokens' graphs in the same calendar month (log scale). (b) Adjusted Rand index between the two tokens' Leiden partitions restricted to shared addresses (months with at least 30 shared addresses); dotted lines give the 95th percentile of 200 label permutations, so points above them indicate that shared addresses co-locate in communities more than chance. (c) PageRank percentile, within each token's common-period graph, of the addresses shared by the pair (boxes without outliers; the grey line is the median over all addresses, 0.5). Shared addresses are identifiers active in both networks, not verified common actors.
graph_definition: undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed) for communities; directed ERC-20 transfer graph of deduplicated transfers; nodes are addresses; self-loops and the zero address removed for PageRank
time_window: common calendar months (a, b); common period of each pair (c)

title: Community overlap between token networks
caption: For each pair of tokens, the addresses active in both networks over the pair's common period are cross-tabulated by their Leiden community in each token's graph. Rows are the communities of the first token holding the most shared addresses, columns those of the second ('other' merges the rest); each cell is the share of the row community's shared addresses that fall in the column community (rows sum to 1, common 0-1 scale). Columns are ordered so that each row's best match lies near the diagonal: a dark diagonal means that addresses grouped together in one token are also grouped together in the other. n is the number of shared addresses; ARI is computed on all of them (overlap_common_period.csv). Absolute counts are in community_overlap_matrix.csv.
graph_definition: undirected projection (reciprocal arc weights summed)
